Such a smooth and easy process. If you are thinking about purchasing Weber grill don’t hesitate it will be a purchase you won’t regret and know that Weber’s customer service is like no other.

Results.ReviewText: I've had my master touch for just over 3 years now and it is a pleasure to cook on. I grill at least 3 times a week. I've also purchased the skillet accessory as well as the rotisserie which works great!! The only issues i have is that one of the stainless bars on the center grill is only welded on one side which my photo will show. Still worked fine though. My big issue is that the adjustment arm for the lower air/quick clean feature has broken off which makes it hard to clean as well as controling the temperature. It seems to have rusted in the spot where the arm is attached. My pics will explain. I still use my grill quite often and hope that my issues are ones that are covered by webers impressive warrenty.

Results.ReviewText: If you haven’t bought a new Webber in some time (my old Webber is still just fine), I really liked the simple but very smart upgrades. The handle on the lid with its heat shield keeps me from having to use a pot holder. The lid holder and the ash catcher are just smart and practical. I had no idea that they now come with so many cooking utensils like the waffle maker etc.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback regarding the Master Touch Charcoal grill. We can understand your frustration. We are here to help. 

It’s completely normal for smoke to come out from between the lid and bowl on a new kettle, and it won’t negatively affect your ability to grill or smoke great food.

The lid and bowls on a brand new kettle often do not form a perfect seal.

Over time, the lid and bowl will form a natural seal of carbon that builds up by using the grill.

However, there may always be a little bit of movement between the lid and bowl, and smoke will occasionally escape, depending on what you're grilling.

Also, on models that come with a lid thermometer, it isn’t unheard of for some smoke to escape from around the thermometer. Reinstalling the thermometer and thermometer bezel to get a better seal might help, but over time the carbon will build up and create a natural seal which will minimize the amount of escaping smoke.

It is hard to say how long it will take for the seal to build up, because it depends on how often you grill as well as what you grill, but it will build up eventually, and in the meantime there is nothing to worry about. 

Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
This new grill is replacing my identical 26 year old kettle grill.  I was happy with the old grill and very pleased with the new one.  I highly recommend the Master Touch model because of the wire lid resting device.  It is much easy to place the lid in the wire semi-circle device than hanging it on a hook as in the standard model.  Another plus for the Master Touch is it's about 2 inch taller than the standard model and my old grill.  Doesn't sound like much but it is noticeable and handy.  
  I wish the Master Touch was available in red like my old grill, even at extra cost so black will have to do.  My old kettle grill will likely be used as an outdoor fire pit or given to a neighbor for a bit of rehabbing and returned to service.  Needs new cooking grate and air shutters.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thanks for your feedback. We understand your frustration, as we expect you to be able to achieve well over 450F with your charcoal grill.

We recommend checking the damper settings on the bottom and top of the grill. Leave the bottom and top dampers fully open to reach the highest heat on your grill. Normally, leaving the bottom completely open and the top damper 1/2-3/4 open will help you reach medium-high temperature.

Preparing the charcoal is also crucial for a successful grilling experience. Please see this article about charcoal grilling for more information:
https://www.weber.com/US/en/blog/burning-questions/how-to-use-a-chimney-starter/weber-30557.html

Our Care team is here to help! Please look for an email outreach from us soon. Thank you!

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
